title: Time for a board to reach reflow temperature
intro: In a reflow oven, the time X for a circuit board to reach soldering temperature is continuous: any value in a range can happen. Over many boards it follows a bell-shaped (normal) density with mean 90 s and standard deviation 6 s. The shaded area is the probability that a board takes between 84 and 96 s. Item 5.3 shows how this area is calculated.
